tone.target: clean arpeggiated alt-rock guitar with light chorus and delay
tone.profile: clean arpeggiated alt-rock guitar with light chorus and delay
tone.summary: A pristine signal chain emphasizing clarity (Comp) and classic Fender-style cleanliness (US Deluxe), enhanced by Chorus and Digital Delay for the required arpeggiated alt-rock sound.
mustHave: clean breakup or very light drive

Provide very light breakup for depth without heavy crunch.
blocks.gap: The Green OD is used sparingly to add warmth, but the primary tone relies on clean amp settings.

Simulate the clean, bright Fender-style tone (Fender clean/British clean clue).
Provide a focused, articulate clean sound suitable for arpeggios.
Slightly boost the upper mids and highs to cut through the mix while maintaining clarity.
blocks.gap: Used for subtle tonal shaping, avoiding a mid-scoop as requested.
